correctness.rationale: The five-bit successor permutations have exactly 2^16 admissible feedback functions g(t); a feedback function produces one circular de Bruijn word iff state 00000 lies in a full 32-state orbit. This bijection exhausts cycles up to rotation without bit complement/reversal quotient. Independent fresh feedback enumeration generated 2048 distinct cycles and parsed all 32 roots of each by a set-based shortest unseen prefix parser, giving c=11:80, 12:7586, 13:55690, 14:2180 and joint (L,H) counts (11,13):6,(11,14):44,(12,13):746,(12,14):1172,(13,13):30,(13,14):50. Source verifier additionally implements distinct Euler tours and trie parsing; both inspected line by line. The finite proof is exhaustive because 2^16 is the complete parametrization.
